name: view_second_hollow_events
description: What happens on the second hollow shows there (contract-m6.md §5): the events give positions local to their hollow, and the views add its origin. In a 2v2 Tide Race the rival team's Toll Tower and cannon stand on the second hollow beside a creep held on its road: the simulation's own pulse (EV_PULSE) rings the bell out from the Toll Tower's cell there, the cannon's shell flies to its landing point on that road and bursts there, not on mine, and a rival's signal rings on the rival's ground. I play the first hollow and watch the second.

steps.assert: Game.my_hollow() == 0 and Game.rival_hollow() == 1 and scene.sim.seat(3).hollow == 1 and scene.sim.seat(4).hollow == 1
steps.msg: my team on the first hollow, the rival team of two on the second
both rival towers stand on the second hollow

steps.assert: cannon.form == 'cannon' and cannon.hollow == 1 and toll.form == 'toll_tower' and toll.hollow == 1
steps.msg: a cannon and a Toll Tower
a creep on the second hollow
held on its own road, in reach of both
the simulation's pulse rings the Toll Tower's bell from its own cell on the second hollow
the shell flies to its landing point on the second hollow's road, where the creep stands
a rival's signal rings on the rival's ground, 26 tiles along from the same point of mine
